objective.comparison: H-Code developer-authored source vs idiomatic TypeScript

description: Frozen scope follows docs/BENCHMARKS.md. No workload may be omitted, cherry-picked, combined or called complete without compiler-level evidence.

workloads.title: Basic calculator CLI
workloads.acceptance: stdin expressions for +,-,*,/ with invalid division; stable stdout/stderr and exit status

workloads.title: Fibonacci recursion
workloads.acceptance: input n=7; stdout 13; recursion and type equivalence against fixed TypeScript baseline

workloads.title: Text frequency counter
workloads.acceptance: normalize and count tokens; deterministic frequency ordering including Unicode cases

workloads.title: CSV reader with validation
workloads.acceptance: parse quoted CSV, reject malformed rows and validate column types deterministically

workloads.title: JSON transformation
workloads.acceptance: deserialize structured input, transform nested typed fields, serialize valid JSON

workloads.title: HTTP client with retries
workloads.acceptance: fake 500/429/200 responses, bounded retries and deterministic trace

workloads.title: Local file conversion
workloads.acceptance: read a file, convert content, write destination and verify bytes

workloads.title: Async concurrent request aggregation
workloads.acceptance: fan out to three deterministic fake HTTP endpoints and combine results without serial blocking

workloads.title: Cache with expiration
workloads.acceptance: fake clock, set/get/expire, prevent stale reads and bounded memory

workloads.title: Generic collection transforms
workloads.acceptance: typed sum, map and filter of arbitrary compatible values with stable outputs

workloads.title: Markdown document processing
workloads.acceptance: parse headings/links into deterministic structured output on an agreed fixture

workloads.title: Basic CRUD API
workloads.acceptance: server endpoints create/read/update/delete, request validation and deterministic persistence

workloads.title: Form validation UI
workloads.acceptance: interactive required/email validation with accessible error feedback

workloads.title: Interactive todo app
workloads.acceptance: add/complete/remove with persisted state and accessible UI updates

workloads.title: Database-backed dashboard
workloads.acceptance: query seeded data, aggregate metrics and render result views

workloads.title: Authentication session handling
workloads.acceptance: issue/rotate/revoke a signed session using deterministic fixture identity

workloads.title: Simple WebSocket chat
workloads.acceptance: two isolated clients, room join, ordered message delivery and disconnect

workloads.title: Unit-test refactor task
workloads.acceptance: refactor a frozen baseline without modifying its required behavior or assertions

workloads.title: Bug reproduction and repair task
workloads.acceptance: reproduce seeded failure, fix actual root cause and verify regression test

workloads.title: Incremental feature on existing app
workloads.acceptance: extend frozen starter app while retaining all prior behavior and passing new acceptance
